resources.string: Standard mode shares Android media information and controls with HY or other apps. UNI and DIM also publish to the car, controlled by the Cluster media card switch. Changes apply on the next CarPlay connection.
In HY, select the mediaSisson scheme and allow access to system media sessions. DiPlay leaves the car’s media card to HY.

UNI MediaCenter requires the ECARX MediaCenter permission and compatible firmware. Permission alone does not guarantee registration. If it fails, diagnostics explain the result; there is no automatic fallback to DIM. This is awaiting validation on the car.
Reading permission and interface details. This does not initialize or register MediaCenter.
An inspection is already in progress. Wait before trying again.
